# GPT website launch instructions

Read docs/current/WEBSITE_LAUNCH_COMMAND.md and the scoped [EAIU-LAUNCH] issue first.
Captain's October 9 sprint uses explicitly selected GPT models. Do not select Auto or delegate to Anthropic/Gemini. A prompt cannot change the running model; if selection is unverified, report the exact launch blocker.

Claim one ready Wxx with model/surface/branch/session evidence. Respect dependencies; Keelforge owns shared-file integration. Maximum three workers and one active branch/session per work order. PR title starts [EAIU-LAUNCH][Wxx]. Update the same issue; no daily duplicate issue flood.

app/page.tsx is the actual homepage. It does not render orphan components/sections. Inspect before changing.
Keep legal/banking records, credentials and volunteer PII private. Validate real volunteer storage/retrieval and accurate donation destination; never fake success or impact/partner claims.
Use approved art; ChatGPT image tools and Tai own new PATCH canon. Ordinary coding capability is not an image/video renderer.
Prepare reviewed code/preview and rollback. Captain approves public release. Cite evidence, not just narrative completion.
